tasks.description: One or more Just recipes to invoke. Maps directly to CLI positionals.

args.description: Positional arguments forwarded after the recipe name.

set.description: Equivalent of `--set KEY=VALUE` per entry. Does NOT override env.

setOverride.description: Equivalent of `--set-override KEY=VALUE`. Overrides variable + env.

env.description: Environment variables injected into process execution.

justfile.description: Path to a specific Justfile. Maps to `--justfile`.

workingDirectory.description: Directory passed to `--working-directory`. Defaults to projectRoot.

dotenvFilename.description: Maps to `--dotenv-filename`. Overrides default .env file name.

dotenvPath.description: Maps to `--dotenv-path`. Directory containing dotenv files.

dotenvOverride.description: Maps to `--dotenv-override`. Dotenv values override environment.

noDotenv.description: Maps to `--no-dotenv` to disable dotenv loading.

dryRun.description: Maps to `--dry-run`. Print commands without executing.

jobs.description: Maps to `--jobs/-j <N>` to set parallel execution.

choose.description: Maps to `--choose`. Allows interactive recipe selection.

check.description: Maps to `--check`. Ensures referenced recipes exist.
